title: Day 1 of SPIE Photonics West
body:
🚀 Day 1 of SPIE Photonics West!

The exhibition kicks off today, and VanaM Inc. 반암(주) is on site. If you’re attending, come visit us to learn more about our advanced thin-films for semiconductors, photonics and optoelectronics.

📍Moscone Center, Booth #3287

See you on the show floor!

#SPIEPW #PhotonicsWest #Photonics #ThinFilms #DeepTech #QuantumWest #Quantum
